outgoingFlows.description: TB infection through transmission from infectious active TB cases.
Progression from latent infection to active TB disease, including rapid progression in the first two years after infection and slow progression/reactivation from remote infection.
Successful treatment of active TB disease.
Natural cure/self-cure from untreated active TB disease.
Relapse from recently treated/recovered TB disease back to active TB disease.
